Equipment Drop Rates

Last updated: 2026-05-22

Hero Summon Drop RatesSkill Summon Drop RatesEquipment Drop RatesMine Pickaxe Drop RatesGate Shard Drop RatesCat Dice Drop Rates

Formula: Equipment draw first selects rarity, then selects one of 8 equipment slots uniformly. Items within the selected rarity and slot are selected uniformly from the currently eligible list.

Note: The game code can prioritize not-yet-owned equipment in the selected rarity and slot. The per-item values below show the base rate when every listed item in the same rarity and slot is eligible. If unowned-priority is active, owned items in that selected group can temporarily have 0% until all items in that group are owned.

Source data: Assets/Resources/Json/equipment_gacha_table.json, Assets/_Heosi/Resources/SO/EquipmentCatalog.asset
